en: I bow to you, the Heruka of both minds, who dwells in the circles of the feet, the secret place, the anus, the navel, the heart, and the head; who resides on the back of Mount Meru; and who abides in the vajra-lotus of the channels and the ritual timing. (1)
I bow to you, Sahaja-Ātma-Heruka, the non-dual and indivisible Tilaka of the Dharmadhātu, who abides in the great sky of the five voids within the pericarp of the secret lotus.

I bow to you, Herukī, Mother of the World, whose brilliance exceeds the fierce mass of lightning flashing from within the layers of dark clouds, and who simultaneously consumes both the world of sentient beings and their physical environment. 3.

I bow to you, who possess the brilliance of the submarine fire, who are born from the union of the vajra and the lotus within the ocean-like hollow of the navel-cakra, and who are eager to drink the essence of the finest nectar.
